Overview

From soft annealed black binding wire for daily rebar tying to galvanised chain-link mesh and high-tensile barbed wire for perimeter fencing, we stock reliable wire products for contractors and fabricators across Rwanda. Tell us the gauge, coating, roll length and quantity required for immediate stock confirmation.

Typical specifications & options

Binding / tying wire
Soft annealed black or galvanised wire (1.2 mm – 2.0 mm) in 20 kg – 25 kg coils
Chain-link fencing
Galvanised and PVC-coated rolls; heights 1.2 m – 2.4 m; apertures 50 mm – 75 mm
Security wire
Double-strand galvanised barbed wire and concertina razor wire coils
General fabrication wire
Plain hard-drawn and heavy galvanised steel wire (2.0 mm – 4.0 mm)

Specifications above reflect typical industry sizes and options in this category. Contact our Kigali desk to confirm current stock and exact grades for your order.
